Prioritization clarification (Phase 1, /dso:prioritize-epics):

This epic adds a session-level "full autonomous mode" toggle that suppresses all prompts to the human — any interaction that would normally pause for user input is handled autonomously instead. The autonomous-handling strategy is defined during brainstorming: where confidence is high, accept a reasonable default; where there is genuine uncertainty that needs careful consideration, escalate to an opus sub-agent rather than to the human. This is targeted at unattended / long-running sessions where the user wants the workflow to make its own judgment calls rather than block on confirmation.
